about: Triaged High and Medium alerts of the security/zap stage. An instance matches an entry when pluginid is equal, uri and param fully match the regexes, and its role is in roles (all roles when roles is left out). verdict is 'false positive', 'real' or 'build room'. A High or Medium instance that matches no entry makes the stage FAIL.

triaged.reason: ZAP's path traversal rule sends the URL's last segment ('spaces', 'space') as the space key; aerie creates a space with that valid key and answers its JSON. No file is read; the key is stored as data. First seen on the admin scan, 2026-11-16.

ZAP's PII rule matched a digit run that passes the card-number checksum, e.g. 4213752181763 and 566996069030158. The answers were refusals (401 or 404) whose RFC 9457 problem body carries a random W3C traceId ('00-<32 hex>-<16 hex>-00'); a fresh answer has a different traceId and no such number. aerie stores no card data. Seen 2026-11-16 on GET /api/v1/admin/spaces/{id} (anonymous), /api/v1/imports/files/id (admin) and /api/v1/ui/plugins (owner, signed out at the time). Matching is by rule for all URLs, so a real card number in an answer would also pass: recheck when this rule fires on a 2xx.
